## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass
- [ ] Follows the code integrity rules in CONTRIBUTING.md (only adds, nothing unused or temporary)
- [ ] User-facing changes follow docs/DESIGN.md
- [ ] New user-facing text is in a String Catalog
- [ ] Checked with VoiceOver and Full Keyboard Access (UI changes)
- [ ] Checked in light and dark mode and with Increase Contrast (UI changes)
- [ ] docs/ARCHITECTURE.md is still accurate
